gather.answer:
### What the evidence shows

security-event-reporting-procedure: “Examples: a stranger in the production hall without a visitor badge, a lost laptop or access card, a suspicious email or link, a warning from your antivirus, an unlocked server room, a colleague asking for your password, or a supplier telling us they have had a security problem.”

training-attendance-record: “Managers: access approvals and incidents | 2026-03-04 | 22 | 20”

security-event-register: “43 reports received: 31 by email or ticket, 12 by the security hotline.”

### What is missing

- S4 is not evidenced.

requirements.reason: The procedure lists what to report across personnel, physical, IT and supplier events; training covers it and attendance is recorded.

citations.quote: Examples: a stranger in the production hall without a visitor badge, a lost laptop or access card, a suspicious email or link, a warning from your antivirus, an unlocked server room, a colleague asking for your password, or a supplier telling us they have had a security problem.

requirements.reason: Email, ticket and hotline are defined, and the register shows reports arriving by each.

citations.quote: 43 reports received: 31 by email or ticket, 12 by the security hotline.
Send ordinary reports by email to security@nordlicht.example or as a ticket in the IT service portal.

requirements.reason: The security desk is reachable by email, ticket and phone.

citations.quote: Send ordinary reports by email to security@nordlicht.example or as a ticket in the IT service portal.

requirements.reason: The security desk is the single point of contact.

citations.quote: The security desk is the single point of contact for all reports.

requirements.reason: A hotline for urgent events, email or ticket for the rest.

citations.quote: For anything urgent, such as an active attack, a stolen device or an intruder on site, call the security hotline on extension 4400, which is staffed during working hours and forwarded to the on-call administrator at other times.

requirements.reason: The duty to report is in the employment contract and the yearly training, which 97 percent completed.

citations.quote: The reporting duty is part of the employment contract and is covered in the yearly awareness training.

requirements.reason: Nothing describes how outside parties report events to Nordlicht; the supplier report in the register came in by chance, not by a defined channel.
Contact details are on the intranet start page and posters by the time clocks.

citations.quote: The contact details are on the intranet start page and on a poster next to every time clock.

requirements.reason: Feedback within two working days is required and recorded per report.

citations.quote: Every report was recorded within one working day; the median time from report to first action was 3 hours.
The security desk tells the reporter what happened to their report within two working days.
